title: Father and Toddler Son, 1950s Vintage B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from around 1950 showing a father kneeling beside his toddler son on a lawn outside a red brick home. The father is dressed in a collared shirt and slacks, while the little boy wears overalls or suspender pants over a striped shirt. The background displays a grassy hill and rural landscape, capturing postwar family life in America.
